Requirement Text: The system shall distinguish between different user roles, such as school administrators, professionals/volunteers, LBB program administrator(s), with varying levels of access and permissions.
Title: User Roles

Requirement Text:
The system shall adhere to the users roles and responsibilities as defined in the following:
School Administrators: Representatives from the schools that participates in the LBB program The scholl administrators is able to view the availabe dates for the academic school year and register for a given LBB event at their school, make changes to requested LBB dates at the school, and provide any logistical information (total instruction time, etc.) the LBB program administrator may need to ensure a smooth event at the school.
LBB Program Administrator: Responsible for the overall scheduling and planning of the LBB events for any given academic school year.  The LBB program administrator has access to view, update, delete any information stored within the LBBS application database(s).
Professional/Volunteers: Professionals and volunteers that offer life skill classes in the LBB program.  The professional/volunteer is able to view available dates for the academic school year at different schools,  register for a given LBB event, make changes to events they have registered for, and provide any logistical information the LBB program administrator may need to ensure a smooth event at the school. 
LBB IT Support Staff: Maintain the LBBS software product and make required enhancements or improvements to the tool as the program evolves from year to year.  Also create and authorize new accounts for new schools, program administrators, volunteers and delete accounts for those that are no longer involved in the LBB program.
Title: User Roles and Responsibilities

Requirement Text: The system shall provide a user-friendly (UI/UX) interface for schools to enroll in the Life Beyond the Books program for a given academic school year.  This includes selecting optimal dates for a LBB event at the school, number of students, indicate whether any students have active photo restrictions in place, and other information helpful in scheduling.
Title: School Information

Requirement Text: The system shall provide a user-friendly (UI/UX) interface for volunteers to enroll in the Life Beyond the Books program events for a given academic school year.  Volunteers are also able to view their schedules and make changes to their schedules throughout the academic year.  Any changes made will be sent to the LBB program administrator.
Title: Volunteer Information

Requirement Text: The system shall collect and store school information securely, making it easier for LBB program administrators to access any given schools information easily and accurately.
Title: School Data Management

Requirement Text: The system shall collect and store professional volunteer's information securely, making it easier for LBB administrators to access any given volunteer's information easily and accurately.  This information includes contact information (email and phone number), a description of the life skills classes that the volunteer would like to teach, and any special requirements the volunteer needs to conduct their class (i.e. outdoor space, classroom size, etc).
Title: Profesional and Volunteer Data Management

Requirement Text: The system software shall include communication tools for Life Beyond the Books administrators to notify and or remind schools and volunteers of upcoming LBB events through email or notifications within the system.
Title: Communication Tools

Requirement Text: The system shall provide LBB program administrators ability to generate reports and analyze application data to gain insights into school and volunteer demographics, trends, and outcomes.
Title: Reporting and Analytics

Requirement Text: The system shall provide the ability for the LBB application to generate surveys for both students and schools that have participated in the program and also for volunteers that have held life skills classes when requested by the LBB program administrator.  The application will also allow the program administrator to transfer survey results into the tool so that metrics and reports can be automatically generated by the application.
Title: Generate and Analyze Surveys

Requirement Text: The system shall provide the LBB application allowing the LBB program administrator to enter financial information into the program's database so that metrics and reports can be generated from the information entered.  The types of financial information tracked include:  monetary donations, grants, in-kind donations of goods or services.
Title: Manage and Track Budgets
